# `Q-5-38` — Unknown website.search Option

> `website.search` has an option Quarto does not recognize. The option
> is ignored.

## What this means

The `website.search` map accepts a fixed set of keys. A key outside
that set is most often a typo, so Quarto reports it rather than
silently dropping it, then renders with the key ignored.

```yaml
# _quarto.yml
website:
  search:
    locaton: sidebar      # Q-5-38: did you mean `location`?
```

The known options are `location`, `type`, `limit`, `collapse-after`,
`copy-button`, `keyboard-shortcut`, `show-item-context`,
`merge-navbar-crumbs`, `federate`, `algolia`, and `search-json`. Inside a `federate`
entry, the known keys are `url`, `title`, `weight`, and `bundle`.

## How to fix it

Correct the spelling, or remove the key. See the website search
documentation for what each option does.
